overview.description: The GraniteShares Autocallable MARA ETF (MRA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is actively managed, investing in a laddered portfolio of single-stock autocallable options referencing the price of MARA Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA) MRA was launched on May 27, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
